evidence.title: Design Minis: the design tools you keep bookmarking

name: Design Minis
summary: Directory of small single-purpose design tools made by designers: colour pickers, type scales, easing curves, shadow generators.
description: A browsable directory of small design tools, each doing one job, spanning colour, typography, motion, icons, images, video, layout, effects, 3D and illustration. Every tool lists a category and a Free or Freemium label; sponsorship slots and free tool submissions are open.
contains: tools listed with a category and a Free or Freemium label
categories: fun, images, motion, svg, effects, layout, video, typography, icons, 3d, illustration
sponsor slots and free tool submissions
